snippet.title: Apu's Journey - New Demo Trailer | Zelda-Inspired RPG | BGS 2024
snippet.description:
Explore the world of Apu's Journey, a thrilling action RPG inspired by classics like Zelda, Hollow Knight, and Castlevania. In this new demo, you'll face dangerous enemies, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on an epic adventure through mystical forests and forgotten ruins.

This demo showcases new areas like the Granite Cave and introduces the fearsome Slime King boss fight. If you're attending BGS 2024, don’t miss out on our live demo at the event!

🔔 Join our community on Discord: Meet other adventurers, share your feedback, and stay updated on all things Apu's Journey by joining our official Discord community: https://discord.com/invite/GJKUZXAVSd

🌐 Follow us on social media for updates:
https://www.instagram.com/apus_journey
https://bsky.app/profile/apusjourney.bsky.social
https://linktr.ee/apus_journey

💻 Wishlist on Steam: Add Apu's Journey to your wishlist on Steam to be notified about new updates, demo releases, and the official launch! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661730/Apus_Journey/
